reader_layers.highschool:
The Idea, Simply

The Master Equation page is now fed by atoms instead of loose notes. The symbols, claims, equations, and fruit audit all come from the same canonical registry.

The Master Equation is the framework's integration center: the place where the ten factor rails become one computable coherence structure.

That means the topbar can show definitions, claims, proof links, math translations, and review warnings from one source of truth.

Lean Corpus Pill

The classified Lean 4 corpus adds a four-number verification pill: 231 files scanned, 8 Tier-S/core files, 2 Master Equation files, and 98 review-needed files. This is a coverage and classification signal, not a blanket proof label.
reader_layers.college:
The Argument

The Master Equation is represented as a computable packet: factor terms become topbar glossary cards, equation atoms become math translation units, and source atoms become claim/proof pairs.

The Master Equation is the framework's integration center: the place where the ten factor rails become one computable coherence structure.

The full equation says coherence is not a sum of nice things. It is a product, so any required channel collapsing matters to the whole.

The fruit audit is also exposed as a callable review layer, so a paper can be judged for visible outputs without confusing first-pass triage with final authority.

  • The machine proof verifies the skeleton: in this architecture, one dead required channel kills the product, and a live product requires all required channels to stay nonzero.
  • Total coherence is the integrated product of ten required factor slots.
  • A required zero channel collapses the product, and product collapse implies a zero channel under the kernel assumptions.
  • Fruit and anti-fruit outputs appear as bounded phase behavior around a coherence threshold.
  • The fruits form a nine-dimensional observable output vector.
